result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but there is a significant text overlap in the restaurant metadata area and some horizontally clipped carousel content that could appear broken or be difficult to access.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata is visibly overlapping: the delivery-time text collides with the delivery fee and cuisine text on the same line, making the information difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Correct the card metadata layout by placing the time, delivery fee, and cuisine in a properly spaced flex row or wrapping them cleanly onto separate lines.

issues.description: The category pill row is cut off at the right edge, with only part of the next pill visible. The restaurant carousel also shows a partially clipped third card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional spacing and a clear scroll affordance, or prevent accidental page overflow while keeping the partially visible card/pill clearly recognizable as scrollable content.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card content is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its image and details are cut off at the viewport bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can be scrolled fully above the fixed navigation bar.
